parameters.jsCode:
const d = items[0].json; const ai = d.ai || {}; const html = `

HVAC Daily Business Brief

Business Health Score: ${d.businessHealthScore}/100

Today's Revenue: $${d.todayRevenue}

Weekly Revenue: $${d.weeklyRevenue}

Monthly Revenue: $${d.monthlyRevenue}

Bookings: ${d.bookings} (Rate: ${d.bookingRate}%)

Top Technician: ${d.topTechnician}

Estimate Conversion: ${d.estimateConversion}%

Review Growth: ${d.reviewGrowth}

AI Executive Summary

${ai.businessSummary || ''}

Today's Priorities

    ${(ai.todaysPriorities||[]).map(p=>'
  • '+p+'
    • ').join('')}
`; return [{ json: { ...d, emailHtml: html } }];
